thread.title: Your first trade for Wednesday, November 14

author: Nia Warfield
title: Your first trade for Wednesday, November 14
text:
The " Fast Money " traders shared their first moves for the market open.
Tim Seymour was a buyer of JPMorgan
Brian Kelly was a buyer of Dunkin' Brands
Steve Grasso was a buyer of Alibaba
Guy Adami was a buyer of Cleveland-Cliffs
